title: LeagueSwype: real-time fantasy sports
summary: Live match scoring with Yahoo data ingestion, secure payments and user management.
impact: Scaled to 10,000+ concurrent users through high-traffic tournament launches.
problem: The client needed a real-time fantasy gaming platform with near-zero-latency scoring, secure user management and seamless payment flows.
solution: Built match-scoring modules and real-time data ingestion from Yahoo, with scalable NestJS backend services designed for high-traffic match windows.
result: Scaled to support 10,000+ concurrent users, reduced critical downtime and supported smooth tournament launches.
